product.description: eos Vanilla Cashmere Body Wash turns your daily shower into a creamy, feel-good body care ritual. This moisturizing body wash gently cleanses while wrapping skin in a warm, decadent vanilla scent with soft cashmere vibes. The pH-balanced formula creates a rich, foamy lather that rinses clean, leaving skin feeling silky, smooth, and comforted. Infused with a nourishing blend of shea butter, cocoa butter, glycerin, vitamin E, and sunflower seed oil, this vanilla body wash helps lock in moisture and support soft, healthy-feeling skin. Designed for women and gynecologist approved, it’s gentle enough for sensitive skin and perfect for everyday use. Complete your routine by layering with Vanilla Cashmere Body Lotion and Body Mist for a long-lasting scent experience.

top_reviews.title: Love Love Love
top_reviews.body: I absolutely am hooked!!!!A friend of mine gifted me a travel size of the lotion for Christmas & since then I've been on this big adventure to ensure I always smell like this!I have eczema and I've always struggled finding a body wash that doesn't make my skin feel like it's going to crack and fall off right after a shower, until I found this! top_reviews.title: Super Moisturizing & Soothing
top_reviews.body: The eos Cashmere Body Wash – Vanilla Cashmere is honestly one of my favorite body washes I’ve used. From the moment you open the bottle, the warm vanilla cashmere scent feels cozy and comforting without being too strong.The gel formula feels smooth and luxurious on the skin, kind of like a soft, creamy lather that doesn’t dry you out. With shea butter, glycerin, and vitamin E, it leaves my skin feeling moisturized and soft even after rinsing. There’s no tight or dry feeling at all. It cleans well without stripping your skin of moisture, making it perfect for daily shower routines.If you want a body wash that cleanses gently, smells amazing, and keeps your skin soft and moisturized, this is a great pick. It turns an ordinary shower into a little self‑care moment, highly recommend.

top_reviews.title: Great Body Wash!

The price is a bit high but, I will pay it because of the high quality wash.
